metadata.name: tracing
metadata.description: DigiSaka tracing program – supply chain tracking

instructions.name: close_batch
docs: Close a batch account (permanently remove from blockchain)
Returns the rent-exempt SOL back to the authority
WARNING: This permanently deletes the account - use with caution

instructions.name: close_drying
docs: Close a drying account (permanently remove from blockchain)
Returns the rent-exempt SOL back to the authority
WARNING: This permanently deletes the account - use with caution

instructions.name: close_milling
docs: Close a milling account (permanently remove from blockchain)
Returns the rent-exempt SOL back to the authority
WARNING: This permanently deletes the account - use with caution

instructions.name: close_season
docs: Close a season account (permanently remove from blockchain)
Returns the rent-exempt SOL back to the authority
WARNING: This permanently deletes the account - use with caution
Optimized to minimize stack usage - avoid accessing account fields

instructions.name: create_batch
docs: Create a new rice batch in the supply chain
PDA seeds: ["batch", authority, batch_id]

instructions.name: create_drying
docs: Create a new drying record in the supply chain
PDA seeds: ["drying", authority, drying_id]

instructions.name: create_milling
docs: Create a new milling record in the supply chain
PDA seeds: ["milling", authority, milling_id]

instructions.name: create_season
docs: Create a new production season in the supply chain
PDA seeds: ["season", authority, season_id]
Uses sentinel values to reduce stack usage (too many Option<String> parameters cause stack overflow)
Sentinels: u64/u16/u32::MAX = not set (per field), i64::MIN = not set, 255 = not set (u8), empty string = not set

accounts.name: from_actor
docs: `CoreActorAccount` off the `try_accounts` stack frame).

instructions.name: delete_batch
docs: Soft delete a rice batch (set is_active = 0)

instructions.name: delete_drying
docs: Soft delete a drying record (set is_active = 0)

instructions.name: delete_milling
docs: Soft delete a milling record (set is_active = 0)

instructions.name: delete_season
docs: Soft delete a production season (set is_active = 0)
Optimized to minimize stack usage - access fields directly without intermediate references

instructions.name: update_batch
docs: Update an existing rice batch

instructions.name: update_drying
docs: Update an existing drying record

instructions.name: update_milling
docs: Update an existing milling record
Sentinels: u32::MAX / u16::MAX / u64::MAX = no update; empty string = no update

instructions.name: update_season
docs: Update an existing production season
Uses sentinel values to reduce stack usage (too many Option<String> parameters cause stack overflow)
Sentinels: u64/u16/u32::MAX = don't update (per field), i64::MIN = don't update, 255 = don't update (u8), empty string = don't update

types.name: BatchAccount
docs: Rice Batch account - represents a batch of rice in the supply chain
PDA seeds: ["batch", authority, batch_id]

types.name: BridgeConfig
docs: Stores the single bridge wallet authorised to sign all
state-mutating instructions in this program.
PDA seeds: [b"bridge_config"]

types.name: DryingAccount
docs: Drying account - represents a drying process for rice batches
PDA seeds: ["drying", authority, drying_id]

types.name: MillingAccount
docs: Milling account - represents a milled rice record in the supply chain
PDA seeds: ["milling", authority, milling_id]

types.name: SeasonAccount
docs: Production Season account - represents a production season in the supply chain
PDA seeds: ["season", authority, season_id]

fields.name: moisture
docs: Basis points (e.g. 1450 = 14.5%). Used `u16` not `u8` — basis points exceed 255.
